name: AnDraw
tagline: Trace images through paper with touch switched off
blurb: AnDraw shows an image full screen and switches off touch, so you can put a sheet of paper on the screen and trace the image without your palm scrolling, zooming or opening something else.
description:
AnDraw shows an image full screen and switches off touch, so you can put a sheet
of paper on the screen and trace the image without your palm scrolling, zooming
or opening something else.

Adjust mode lets you place the image: pinch to zoom, drag to move, and buttons to
rotate and mirror. Press Lock to enter tracing mode, where every touch is
swallowed, the screen is kept awake, and brightness goes to maximum so the image
shines through the paper.

Any volume key switches between the two modes, and the volume itself never
changes.

AnDraw requests no permissions at all. Images are opened through the system file
picker, which gives the app access to the single file you choose and nothing
else.
